name: The Dawn of Compassion
source:
You follow the story of Ezra, an ordinary teenager. The trouble arises when that ordinariness turns into monotony, and that is the greatest struggle in his daily life. On top of that, he has to deal with old memories of a certain boy that keep coming back to haunt him.

[Translated from [url=https://mckenziew.itch.io/the-dawn-of-compassion-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将跟随以斯拉（Ezra）的故事，一个普通的青少年。当平凡变得单调时，麻烦就出现了，这是他日常生活中最大的挣扎。最重要的是，他必须处理某个男孩的旧记忆，这些记忆不断地困扰着他。

[译自[url=https://mckenziew.itch.io/the-dawn-of-compassion-demo]itch.io[/url]]
